from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEmployeePayable(BaseModel):
    """One company's Employee Benefits Payable (应付职工薪酬) from their financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The Employee Benefits Payable amount at period end")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The period end date for this financial report")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, typically 元 for Chinese financial reports")
    label: str = Field(description="The line item label as written in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_employee_payables: list[CompanyEmployeePayable]
